cohort: 17,842 married women aged 15-49 in Bangladesh, focusing on early childbearing mothers (age <= 24, and who had delivered their first child <= 20).
finding: Young mothers from rural areas, poor families, those with lower education, working mothers with unemployed husbands, and those who had non-caesarean deliveries, delivered at home, married early, and had more than two children were at higher risk of being underweight.
mod_finding: Young mothers who had non-caesarean delivered and delivered at home were at higher risk for being underweight.
